SecretDto.description: Project-specific secret necessary to create unique encodings per project, that is is only known to the data owners

project.description: Unique name of the record-linkage project
Unique name of the record-linkage project

validation.description: Description of requirements for this scheme

config.description: Configuration / parameters to build the encoder

supportedEncodingMethods.description: List of encoding methods that can be matched with this scheme

EncodingRequestDto.description: Request for encoding a single record that is included in the request.

EncodingRetrievalRequestDto.description: Request description for encoding a single record. The record itself is not part of the request, but retrieved from the database using its id.

MultiRecordEncodingRetrievalRequestDto.description: Request description for encoding multiple records from the same dataset with the same encoding. No record-specific secret is required or possible.

recordIds.description: List of record ids to encode. If empty, all records of the dataset are encoded.

DataSetGeneratorConfig.description: Configuration for generating the corrupted dataset

originalSize.description: Number of records from the original source

modifiedSize.description: Number of records from the modified source

sourceOverlap.description: Share of records from original source that have a duplicate in modified source

inputFilter.description: Filter the input records before using them in the generator

sourceModifierConfigs.description: Modifiers to sequentially apply on the input records before creating the modified two-source dataset

duplicateModifierConfigs.description: Modifiers to create true matches and true non-matches

seed.description:
Global seed for randomness, e.g., when shuffling the input records before corruption
 Take care: Does not necessarily affect random selectors within modifier configs!

modifierDistributionStrategy.description: Setting on how to apply the duplicateModifierConfigs

inputDatasetId.description: ID of the dataset used for the original records of the corrupted dataset

outputDatasetId.description: ID of the generated dataset. If missing, it will be autogenerated.

config.description: Configuration for the corrupter. Either config or configCreator must be set.

configCreator.description: Configuration for creating a corruption config from a template. Either config or configCreator must be set.

referenceDatasetId.description: ID of the dataset whose records and attribute value (frequencies) are used as the source for generated records. If empty or 0, the input dataset will be used instead

name.description: Name of the dataset modification config

override.description: Configuration settings which override the generated config parameters

MultiRecordEncodingRequestDto.description: Request for encoding multiple records using the same method. The records are included in the request.

EncodingCreationRequestDto.description: Request for creating an encoding definition.

attributeErrorRates.description: Precomputed/estimated error rates.Required if sourceSpecific = true because the error rate cannot be determined per source.

sourceSpecificAttributeWeights.description: Attribute weights for each data source. Only relevant if sourceSpecific = true.

sourceSpecificAttributeLength.description: Attribute lengths for each data source. Only relevant if sourceSpecific = true.

sources.description: Names of sources. Only relevant for sourceSpecific = true and WeightSelectionMethod.None.

EncodingCreationResponseDto.description: Response of creating an encoding definition.

request.description: Request description with auto-generated dataset-based properties
